Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ahip-demo-disability-codes

Language: en

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/us/demographic-collect/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-disability-codes defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
HEAR HearingDeafness or serious difficulty hearing because of a physical or mental health condition.
SEEI Seeing (even when wearing glasses)Blindness or serious difficulty seeing, even when wearing glasses, because of a physical or mental health condition.
WALK Walking or climbing stairsSerious difficulty walking or climbing stairs because of a physical or mental health condition.
CONC Concentrating, remembering, or making decisionsSerious difficulty concentrating, remembering, or making decisions because of a physical or mental health condition.
DRES Dressing or bathingDifficulty dressing or bathing because of a physical or mental health condition.
COOK Cooking for oneselfDifficulty cooking for oneself because of a physical or mental health condition.
FEED Feeding oneselfDifficulty feeding oneself because of a physical or mental health condition.
TOIL Using the toiletDifficulty using the toilet because of a physical or mental health condition.
ERRA Doing errands alone, such as shopping or visiting a doctor’s officeDifficulty doing errands alone, such as shopping or visiting a doctor's office, because of a physical or mental health condition.
COMM Communicating or being understood using your usual languageDifficulty communicating or being understood using one's usual language because of a physical or mental health condition.
UNDE Understanding when someone speaks in your usual languageDifficulty understanding when someone speaks in one's usual language because of a physical or mental health condition.
